rules.topic: Modular storage module capacities in stacks (tier index 0-3): 100, 200, 300 and 500 stacks; each stack can hold a full item stack, so the top module is 500 stacks in a single storage block; index 6 (-1) is the unlimited creative module

Remote storage access is powered: the remote storage module holds 100000 RF and recharges at 300 RF/t (line 57); the storage tablet holds 20000 RF, charges at 500 RF/t and spends 100 RF per use - cross-dimension or long-range storage is never free in this family
